members.name: b77_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer wants? Pick the single most specific intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a newly received card; how to activate, activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service; can children/teenagers use it.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Anything about Apple Pay, Google Pay, Android Pay or a smartwatch: using them with the card, adding the card to them, and topping up through them — including a top-up via Apple Pay or Google Pay that isn't working.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, using ATMs in general.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Anything about the auto top-up feature: setting it up, how it works, its limits or amounts, turning it off.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer made or expects a specific bank transfer into their own account and it is not showing / the balance hasn't updated yet, even if they also ask about the time frame (e.g. 'How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I just made one and it isn't showing', 'Why is it taking so long to update my balance transfer?').
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A deposit (cheque or cash deposit) the customer made has not appeared in the balance yet, e.g. 'when will my deposit show up', 'I deposited some money but it isn't showing up'.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Trouble sending money to a beneficiary/payee, cannot add a beneficiary, or the beneficiary is not allowed / rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wanting to cancel or reverse a transfer the customer made (e.g. sent to the wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring soon: getting a replacement for an expiring/expired card, what happens at expiry.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; merchants or shops that don't accept it.
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered physical card has not arrived yet; tracking the card delivery; plastic card still not received.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; when will a new card arrive; express delivery options (asked before a problem).
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account/app; re-linking or adding a card that was found.
criteria.card_not_working: The card itself is not working, broken or damaged, e.g. 'it just didn't work' in several places (the customer does not describe payments being declined).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase (the customer does not call it a transfer).
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment, purchase, or payment on the statement or app that the customer does not recognise or says they didn't make or buy, e.g. 'I didn't make a payment that shows in my app', 'Why is this payment on my app', 'there is a payment on my statement I don't recognise', 'I have a charge for something I didn't buy'.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The wrong exchange rate was applied to a card payment made abroad / in a foreign currency, or the customer says there is an error with the rate they were charged.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make or doesn't recognise.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the PIN; where to change the PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may have been compromised, hacked or used fraudulently by someone else (the customer still has the card).
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available or supported in; whether support/service is available for the customer; using the account while living in another country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: Card payments were declined / rejected / refused at a shop, restaurant or online, including a new card that keeps getting declined (the customer does not call it a transfer).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined / refused.
criteria.declined_transfer: Something the customer calls a transfer was declined/denied/rejected, or the customer is not allowed to make it — even if they also mention a purchase or card.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer doesn't recognise, or a charge to the account that the customer says they didn't make, authorise or recognise when nothing suggests a purchase, a shop, a card or an amount (e.g. 'I do not know what this charge is for', 'I have an unauthorized charge', 'My account's been charged a payment for something I didn't make').
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, how many can be created, restrictions.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, email, phone number.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees, charges or costs for exchanging currency, including whether frequent exchangers get a discount on the cost of exchanging.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used / where exchange rates come from / current rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge or small extra fee on the statement (e.g. an extra £1/€1, a £1 charge the customer doesn't recognise).
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer or large payment (e.g. paying for a flat/house or a mortgage) failed, showed an error, didn't go through, or bounced back.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding or exchanging; is a particular currency available.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Getting/creating a disposable virtual card; how disposable cards work.
criteria.get_physical_card: How to get a physical card to go with the account or virtual card (not about its cost); where to find or how to get the PIN of the card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second card or ordering another card (on top of the current one), e.g. for a family member; how many cards one can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting a (non-disposable) virtual card: how to obtain or create one, or not having received a virtual card yet.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen, or the customer wants to freeze/block their card immediately.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone was lost or stolen; accessing the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a (new) physical card, and any question about the cost or fees of getting a physical card (e.g. 'I need a physical card. What are the fees?', 'Do I receive the physical card for free'); card delivery to a particular country.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / login password; resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase that is still pending, or a message saying their 'payment' hasn't gone through yet / is taking a while (word 'payment', not 'transfer', 'transaction' or 'top-up'). Not for payments the customer doesn't recognise.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up the customer says is still pending / processing, waiting for it to complete.
criteria.pending_transfer: A specific transfer of the customer's that is pending, still processing, or taking far too long (e.g. 'I've been waiting forever for this international transfer, why is it taking so long?') — but if they say their balance hasn't updated it is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer, and if a payee hasn't received or been posted the money it is transfer_not_received_by_recipient.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; card blocked because of PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / get paid into the account; receiving salary or payments.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Requesting a refund for a purchase; how to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A payment to a seller/merchant was reverted / returned / bounced back to the account (e.g. the seller says the money didn't go through; it was deducted and then came back), or a purchase the customer paid for has disappeared from the account / no longer shows.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (e.g. card brands) and currencies are supported, and which payment methods are accepted for adding funds / topping up.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up (not via Apple Pay/Google Pay) failed, was declined, didn't work, or the customer is unsure whether it went through / thinks something went wrong with it.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on regular (not automatic) top-ups: maximum/minimum amounts, how much can be topped up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (money the customer added to their own account) was reverted / cancelled, or the customer topped up (recharged) but the account was not credited / the top-up money was returned or disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up / add money to the account (e.g. with a card), and who can top up the account, including whether other people can top it up. Not topping up via Apple Pay / Google Pay / a smartwatch (that is apple_pay_or_google_pay).
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicate payment.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on something the customer calls a transfer — even if they also describe it as an online purchase or payment.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / top up by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: An outgoing transfer or transaction the customer made that hasn't gone through / been posted / arrived on the recipient's side (a person, retailer or payee), e.g. 'Why hasn't my in-country transfer gone through yet? I confirmed the account info days ago but the payment hasn't been posted', 'Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?'.
criteria.transfer_timing: Questions about how long transfers take or how much longer to wait, e.g. 'how long does a transfer from Europe take', 'I'm waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?' — not complaints that a specific transfer is pending or taking far too long, not transfers sent to someone else, not transfers already made that are not showing up.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Problems verifying identity; verification not working or failing.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds / where money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code for a card top-up; verifying a top-up card.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work / is declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Anything about Visa or Mastercard: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them, whether Visa or Mastercard is accepted.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The wrong exchange rate was applied to a cash withdrawal abroad.

criteria.cancel_transfer: Choose when: Wanting to cancel or reverse a transfer the customer made (e.g. sent to the wrong account).
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Choose when: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Choose when: Anything about Apple Pay, Google Pay, Android Pay or a smartwatch: using them with the card, adding the card to them, and topping up through them — including a top-up via Apple Pay or Google Pay that isn't working.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Choose when: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicate payment.
criteria.pending_transfer: Choose when: A specific transfer of the customer's that is pending, still processing, or taking far too long (e.g. 'I've been waiting forever for this international transfer, why is it taking so long?') — but if they say their balance hasn't updated it is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer, and if a payee hasn't received or been posted the money it is transfer_not_received_by_recipient.
criteria.declined_card_payment: Choose when: Card payments were declined / rejected / refused at a shop, restaurant or online, including a new card that keeps getting declined (the customer does not call it a transfer).
criteria.pin_blocked: Choose when: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; card blocked because of PIN.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Choose when: Which cards (e.g. card brands) and currencies are supported, and which payment methods are accepted for adding funds / topping up.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Choose when: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Choose when: Getting/creating a disposable virtual card; how disposable cards work.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Choose when: A refund from a merchant has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Choose when: Getting a (non-disposable) virtual card: how to obtain or create one, or not having received a virtual card yet.
criteria.card_not_working: Choose when: The card itself is not working, broken or damaged, e.g. 'it just didn't work' in several places (the customer does not describe payments being declined).
criteria.verify_top_up: Choose when: Verification code for a card top-up; verifying a top-up card.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Choose when: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding or exchanging; is a particular currency available.
criteria.request_refund: Choose when: Requesting a refund for a purchase; how to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.atm_support: Choose when: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, using ATMs in general.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Choose when: An outgoing transfer or transaction the customer made that hasn't gone through / been posted / arrived on the recipient's side (a person, retailer or payee), e.g. 'Why hasn't my in-country transfer gone through yet? I confirmed the account info days ago but the payment hasn't been posted', 'Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?'.
criteria.failed_transfer: Choose when: A transfer or large payment (e.g. paying for a flat/house or a mortgage) failed, showed an error, didn't go through, or bounced back.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Choose when: The customer made or expects a specific bank transfer into their own account and it is not showing / the balance hasn't updated yet, even if they also ask about the time frame (e.g. 'How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I just made one and it isn't showing', 'Why is it taking so long to update my balance transfer?').
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Choose when: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase (the customer does not call it a transfer).
criteria.transfer_into_account: Choose when: How to transfer money into the account / top up by bank transfer.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Choose when: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined / refused.
criteria.terminate_account: Choose when: Closing or deleting the account.
criteria.card_arrival: Choose when: An ordered physical card has not arrived yet; tracking the card delivery; plastic card still not received.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Choose when: Anything about the auto top-up feature: setting it up, how it works, its limits or amounts, turning it off.
criteria.declined_transfer: Choose when: Something the customer calls a transfer was declined/denied/rejected, or the customer is not allowed to make it — even if they also mention a purchase or card.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Choose when: A fee was charged on something the customer calls a transfer — even if they also describe it as an online purchase or payment.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Choose when: Trouble sending money to a beneficiary/payee, cannot add a beneficiary, or the beneficiary is not allowed / rejected.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: Choose when: A cash withdrawal is still pending.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Choose when: How long card delivery takes; when will a new card arrive; express delivery options (asked before a problem).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Choose when: Problems verifying identity; verification not working or failing.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Choose when: Card expiring soon: getting a replacement for an expiring/expired card, what happens at expiry.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Choose when: A deposit (cheque or cash deposit) the customer made has not appeared in the balance yet, e.g. 'when will my deposit show up', 'I deposited some money but it isn't showing up'.
criteria.receiving_money: Choose when: How to receive money / get paid into the account; receiving salary or payments.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Choose when: A fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Choose when: The card was lost or stolen, or the customer wants to freeze/block their card immediately.
